prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins, and the decider is Clinton's email controversy. The Union Square tarot reading on the 2016 election points to Trump taking the White House on 8 November 2016; what decides it is the Clinton email/Foundation affair — a late resurgence of that scandal in the final stretch breaks Clinton's lead. Timing: decided 8 November 2016, with the deciding blow landing in the last two weeks of the campaign.
basis:

systems_used: Tarot election reading (Waite tradition) + factual controversy faces given in card

Faces listed: main face = who wins and what decides it; event faces = Clinton leads in August polls; email controversy and Clinton Foundation already public controversies (card-given). Retained as tendency-level on the decider mechanism (late resurgence), identity claim kept.
